Name: Jojinho seu amiguinho
Author: feandrad
Description:
[PORTUGUÊS BR]

Arte criada por: https://www.instagram.com/pobrecabraa/

Adiciona uma nova decoração para sua fazendo, o Jojinho, seu amiguinho.

Compre ela na loja Joja mais próxima e demonstre seu amor pela marca!


[ENGLISH]

Art created by: https://www.instagram.com/pobrecabraa/

Adds a new decoration for you farm, Jojinho, your little friend!

You can buy it at your local Joja mart and share your love for the brand!

Downloads.Description:
You can add the code below as one of the entries of the Joja.json Items.
Here is a changed file is you don't need any customizations, just override the Joja.json file.
The only change my mod added is the entry in line 242, if your file is modified.

Mods.DisplayName: Jojinho SDV Extended Compat\Stardew Valley Expanded\[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded\code\Shops\vanilla
Mods.RelativePath: Jojinho SDV Extended Compat\Stardew Valley Expanded\[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded\code\Shops\vanilla
Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it contains files, but none of them are manifest.json.
